models.name: App
models.description: A dynamic application block that fetches user data from a configured API endpoint.

component.label: Data Source Configuration (userApi)
component.description: Select or configure the backend service endpoint for user data retrieval.

component.label: Initial Filter Parameters (Optional)
component.description: Set default filters, search terms, or pagination limits for the initial API call.

component.label: Visible User Scope
component.description: Defines the scope of users visible to the authoring user (e.g., 'Users in Department X' vs. 'All Users'). Critical for security.
